en.title: Security Summit: Strengthen defenses against tax identity theft
en.summary: The Internal Revenue Service and the Security Summit today urged tax professionals and taxpayers to strengthen defenses against tax-related identity theft.

en.title: IRS reminder: National Payroll Week is time for a paycheck checkup
en.summary: The Internal Revenue Service today encouraged workers and employers to review withholding and payroll tax responsibilities ahead of National Payroll Week.

en.title: IRS Reminder: Disaster preparedness starts with tax records
en.summary: The Internal Revenue Service today encouraged taxpayers to protect important tax and financial records before disaster strikes.
